places.name: Reservoir
places.description: Hillcrest reservoir state: level, clock, pump mode and overflow counter arming.

places.name: OverflowEvents
places.description: One token is added each time the model first reaches overflow depth after being re-armed below the overflow level.

places.name: FireReserveBreaches
places.description: One token is added when the model first falls to or below the fire reserve floor in an excursion.

places.name: LowMorningEvents
places.description: One token is added for each morning check window where the reservoir is below the practical 06:30 floor.

transitions.name: Switch pump on
transitions.description: Pump starts when the reservoir level is at or below cut-in.
transitions.lambdaCode:
const token = input.Reservoir[0];
return !token.pump_on && token.level_m <= parameters.cut_in_level_m;
transitions.transitionKernelCode:
const token = input.Reservoir[0];
return { Reservoir: [{ level_m: token.level_m, time_hours: token.time_hours, overflow_armed: token.overflow_armed, pump_on: true, reserve_armed: token.reserve_armed, morning_check_armed: token.morning_check_armed }] };

transitions.name: Switch pump off
transitions.description: Pump stops when the reservoir level is at or above cut-out.
transitions.lambdaCode:
const token = input.Reservoir[0];
return token.pump_on && token.level_m >= parameters.cut_out_level_m;
transitions.transitionKernelCode:
const token = input.Reservoir[0];
return { Reservoir: [{ level_m: token.level_m, time_hours: token.time_hours, overflow_armed: token.overflow_armed, pump_on: false, reserve_armed: token.reserve_armed, morning_check_armed: token.morning_check_armed }] };

transitions.name: Count overflow
transitions.description: Adds one overflow event when level first reaches reservoir depth after being re-armed.
transitions.lambdaCode:
const token = input.Reservoir[0];
return token.overflow_armed && token.level_m >= parameters.reservoir_depth_m;
transitions.transitionKernelCode:
const token = input.Reservoir[0];
return { Reservoir: [{ level_m: Math.min(token.level_m, parameters.reservoir_depth_m), time_hours: token.time_hours, overflow_armed: false, pump_on: token.pump_on, reserve_armed: token.reserve_armed, morning_check_armed: token.morning_check_armed }] };

transitions.name: Re-arm overflow counter
transitions.description: Allows a later spill to be counted after the level has fallen below overflow depth.
transitions.transitionKernelCode:
const token = input.Reservoir[0];
return { Reservoir: [{ level_m: token.level_m, time_hours: token.time_hours, overflow_armed: true, pump_on: token.pump_on, reserve_armed: token.reserve_armed, morning_check_armed: token.morning_check_armed }] };

transitions.name: Count fire reserve breach
transitions.description: Adds one breach token when reservoir level first falls to or below the fire reserve floor in an excursion.
transitions.lambdaCode:
const token = input.Reservoir[0];
return token.reserve_armed && token.level_m <= parameters.fire_reserve_floor_m;
transitions.transitionKernelCode:
const token = input.Reservoir[0];
return { Reservoir: [{ level_m: token.level_m, time_hours: token.time_hours, overflow_armed: token.overflow_armed, pump_on: token.pump_on, reserve_armed: false, morning_check_armed: token.morning_check_armed }] };

transitions.name: Re-arm fire reserve counter
transitions.description: Allows a later fire-reserve breach to be counted after level recovers above the floor.
transitions.transitionKernelCode:
const token = input.Reservoir[0];
return { Reservoir: [{ level_m: token.level_m, time_hours: token.time_hours, overflow_armed: token.overflow_armed, pump_on: token.pump_on, reserve_armed: true, morning_check_armed: token.morning_check_armed }] };

transitions.name: Count low 06:30 level
transitions.description: Adds one token during the 06:30 check window when level is below the practical morning floor.
transitions.transitionKernelCode:
const token = input.Reservoir[0];
return { Reservoir: [{ level_m: token.level_m, time_hours: token.time_hours, overflow_armed: token.overflow_armed, pump_on: token.pump_on, reserve_armed: token.reserve_armed, morning_check_armed: false }] };

transitions.name: Re-arm morning check
transitions.description: Re-arms the practical 06:30 level check after the morning check window has passed.
transitions.transitionKernelCode:
const token = input.Reservoir[0];
return { Reservoir: [{ level_m: token.level_m, time_hours: token.time_hours, overflow_armed: token.overflow_armed, pump_on: token.pump_on, reserve_armed: token.reserve_armed, morning_check_armed: true }] };

types.name: Reservoir state
types.description: One token carries Hillcrest's water level, simulation clock, and whether a new overflow can be counted.

differentialEquations.name: Reservoir level and clock dynamics

scenarios.name: Summer nights with cut-out and VSD levers
scenarios.description: Starts Hillcrest at an editable level and runs through repeated summer night/morning demand cycles. Upstream supply is represented only by pump inflow.

metrics.name: Overflow event count
metrics.description: Number of overflow events counted so far in the run.

metrics.name: Reservoir level
metrics.description: Current modelled Hillcrest reservoir level in metres.
metrics.code:
const tokens = state.places.Reservoir.tokens;
return tokens.length === 0 ? 0 : tokens[0].level_m;

metrics.name: Pump running
metrics.description: 1 when the pump is on, 0 when it is off.
metrics.code:
const tokens = state.places.Reservoir.tokens;
return tokens.length > 0 && tokens[0].pump_on ? 1 : 0;

metrics.name: Fire reserve breach count
metrics.description: Number of excursions at or below the 1.5 m fire reserve floor.

metrics.name: Low 06:30 event count
metrics.description: Number of morning check windows where the reservoir is below the practical 3.0 m floor.
